examples.explanation: One valid trace: [1,0] and [2,0] are flipped, then the last free cell [0,0]; after reset any cell (here [2,0]) may come first.
Draining a 2x2 board must return each of the four cells exactly once, in any order.
Reset clears the flipped set, so the single cell may be flipped again.

hints: Treat the board as virtual indices 0..m*n-1 and draw without replacement Fisher-Yates style: keep a remap table from drawn slots to still-unused ones so each flip costs O(1) random calls.
Convert a drawn index k to coordinates via [k / n, k % n].
Reset just clears the remap table and restores the pool size to m * n.
title: 519. Random Flip Matrix
